mcq.q: What is turn-taking in a conversation?
options: Both people speak at the same time
One person speaks while the other listens, then they swap
One person speaks all the time
mcq.explanation: In turn-taking each speaker waits for the other to finish before speaking.

mcq.q: Which phrase is a polite way of adding to what someone said?
mcq.explanation: 'May I add something?' asks permission politely.

mcq.q: Which sentence talks about a finished action in the past?
options: Kamau buys data bundles every week.
Kamau is buying data bundles now.
Kamau will buy data bundles tomorrow.
mcq.explanation: 'Bought' and 'yesterday' show the action is finished.

mcq.q: Which sentence shows a habit in the present tense?
options: I always ask my mother before opening a new page.
mcq.explanation: 'Always' and the simple present 'ask' show a habit.

mcq.q: Which word contains the sound /ɛə/?
mcq.explanation: 'Chair' ends with the /ɛə/ sound.

mcq.q: Which word begins with the sound /j/?
mcq.explanation: 'Yellow' begins with /j/, the y sound. 'Jam' and 'giant' begin with /ʤ/.

mcq.q: Which word has the soft buzzing sound /ʒ/ in the middle?
mcq.explanation: 'Television' has /ʒ/. 'Jug' and 'bridge' have /ʤ/.

mcq.q: What is a stranger?
options: A person who lives next door
A person you do not know
mcq.explanation: A stranger is someone you do not know.

mcq.q: What are data bundles?
options: An amount of internet you buy for a phone or computer
mcq.explanation: Data bundles are bought to use the internet.

mcq.q: Which is the best thing to do if an online message makes you afraid?
options: Show it to a trusted adult at once
Send it to all your friends
mcq.explanation: A trusted adult can help you stay safe.

mcq.q: Which word has the /ʤ/ sound at the beginning?
mcq.explanation: In 'giraffe' the g says /ʤ/.

mcq.q: Which word has the /j/ sound although it begins with the letter u?
mcq.explanation: 'Use' is said 'yooz', beginning with /j/.

mcq.q: Which is a good listening habit?
options: Shout answers before the question ends
mcq.explanation: Looking at the speaker shows you are listening.

mcq.q: Which word means 'free time when you rest or play'?
mcq.explanation: Leisure is free time.

mcq.q: What is extensive reading?
options: Choosing materials and reading a lot on your own for pleasure and learning
Studying one text word by word with the teacher
mcq.explanation: Extensive reading is wide, independent reading.

mcq.q: In the five-finger test, what does it mean if you use all five fingers on one page?
options: The book is probably too hard for now
mcq.explanation: Five unknown words on a page suggests the book is too hard.

mcq.q: What is a graded reader?
options: A book written at a level of difficulty suited to certain readers
mcq.explanation: Graded readers are written at different reading levels.

mcq.q: Which of these tells you what a book is about before you read it?
mcq.explanation: The back cover gives a short summary.

mcq.q: What does the proverb 'Look before you leap' mean?
options: Jump as high as you can
mcq.explanation: It advises us to think before we do something.

mcq.q: What does the proverb 'A friend in need is a friend indeed' mean?
options: A true friend helps you when you are in trouble
Friends should never ask for help
mcq.explanation: A true friend is seen when we need help.

mcq.q: To retell a story, which things should you say?
options: Who, where, what happened and how it ended
mcq.explanation: A retelling covers characters, place, events and ending.

mcq.q: What is a rhyme?
options: Words that start with the same letter
Words that end with the same sound
mcq.explanation: 'Wide' and 'ride' rhyme.

mcq.q: Why is it good to write new words and meanings in a notebook while reading?
mcq.explanation: Writing new words helps you remember them.

mcq.q: Which online reading habit is safe?
options: Visiting any page a stranger suggests
Giving your address to a website
Reading only pages approved by a teacher or parent
mcq.explanation: Approved pages keep you safe online.

mcq.q: In the story 'The Boy and the Borrowed Phone', what did Otieno do with the strange message?
options: He sent it to his class
He showed it to his aunt
mcq.explanation: He remembered his teacher's advice and asked an adult.

mcq.q: Which is NOT a good way to run a reading club?
options: Keep a list of books read
mcq.explanation: A club needs turn-taking so everyone is heard.

mcq.q: Which sentence is in the present progressive?
options: The teacher had marked our books.
The teacher is marking our books.
mcq.explanation: Is + verb-ing shows an action happening now.

mcq.q: Choose the correct -ing form of 'make'.
mcq.explanation: Verbs ending in silent e drop the e before -ing.

mcq.q: Choose the correct -ing form of 'run'.
mcq.explanation: Short verbs ending in one vowel and one consonant double the last letter.

mcq.q: Choose the correct -ing form of 'play'.
mcq.explanation: A verb ending in y keeps the y before -ing.

mcq.q: Which helping verb completes: 'They ____ watching TV when the power went off.'?
mcq.explanation: 'They' takes 'were' in the past progressive.

mcq.q: Which helping verb completes: 'I ____ writing a letter now.'?
mcq.explanation: 'I' takes 'am' in the present progressive.

mcq.q: Which sentence shows two actions going on at the same time in the past?
options: I cooked and my sister washes plates.
I am cooking and my sister was washing plates.
I was cooking while my sister was washing plates.
I have cooked while she washed.
mcq.explanation: 'While' links two past progressive actions.

mcq.q: Which verb is NOT normally used in the progressive form?
mcq.explanation: 'Know' describes a state, not an action in progress.

mcq.q: How do you make the question form of 'She is reading'?
mcq.explanation: Put is before the subject.

mcq.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I was walk to school when it started to rain.
I was walking to school when it started to rain.
I am walking to school when it started to rain.
I walking to school when it started to rain.
mcq.explanation: Past progressive was + verb-ing, with the simple past for the shorter action.

mcq.q: What is the negative form of 'We are shouting'?
mcq.explanation: Not comes after are.

mcq.q: Choose the correct -ing form of 'lie' (to rest flat).
mcq.explanation: The letters ie change to y before -ing.

mcq.q: Which time word usually goes with the present progressive?
mcq.explanation: 'At the moment' shows an action happening now.

mcq.q: What is the job of a full stop?
options: To end a statement or a command
mcq.explanation: A full stop ends statements and commands.

mcq.q: Which word needs a capital letter?
mcq.explanation: Days of the week begin with capital letters.

mcq.q: Which of these is a proper noun?
mcq.explanation: Mombasa is the name of a particular town.

mcq.q: Which is written correctly?
mcq.explanation: The first word and the mountain name need capitals, and a statement ends with a full stop.

mcq.q: How should the initials of Peter Otieno Juma be written?
mcq.explanation: Capital initials each followed by a full stop.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a run-on sentence that needs full stops?
options: I went to the market I bought fish we went home.
mcq.explanation: Three ideas are run together without full stops.

mcq.q: When do we write the word 'I' as a capital letter?
options: Only at the start of a sentence
mcq.explanation: 'I' is always a capital.

mcq.q: Which month is written correctly?
mcq.explanation: September is spelt with a capital S and the ending -ber.

mcq.q: Which of these does NOT need a capital letter?
mcq.explanation: Seasons are common nouns and take small letters.

mcq.q: Which sentence is correct?
mcq.explanation: Names and the first word begin with capitals, and the statement ends with a full stop.

mcq.q: What is an abbreviation?
options: A short way of writing a word or group of words
mcq.explanation: For example Dr. for Doctor.

mcq.q: Which sentence tells someone to do something and ends with a full stop?
mcq.explanation: Commands usually end with a full stop.

short.q: State two habits of a good listener.
short.answer: Look at the speaker and keep quiet until the speaker has finished a whole idea. Nodding to show you follow is also correct.

short.q: Write two polite phrases you could use in a conversation, one to add something and one to give the other person a turn.
short.answer: For example: 'May I add something?' and 'What do you think?'
short.working: 1 mark for each suitable polite phrase.

short.q: Rewrite in the past tense: 'I watch a video and I learn a new word.'
short.answer: I watched a video and I learned (learnt) a new word.
short.working: 1 mark for watched, 1 mark for learned/learnt.

short.q: Give two pieces of advice for staying safe online.
short.answer: Do not give your name, school or address to strangers. Show worrying messages to a trusted adult. Ask a parent or teacher before opening a new page.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct piece of advice, up to 3.

short.q: Write two words that contain /ɛə/, two that begin with /j/ and one that has /ʒ/.
Explain the difference between intensive and extensive reading.
short.answer: Intensive reading is reading a short text closely, often with the class, to understand it fully. Extensive reading is choosing materials and reading a lot on your own for pleasure and learning.
short.working: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 mark for the difference in choice or amount.

short.q: Describe the five-finger test for choosing a book.
short.answer: Open the book at a page and read it. Hold up a finger for every word you do not know. Five fingers means too hard; one to three fingers is a good fit.
short.working: 1 mark for reading a page, 1 for counting unknown words with fingers, 1 for what five fingers means, 1 for what one to three fingers means.

short.q: Explain what the proverb 'Many hands make light work' means and give an example.
short.answer: It means a job is easier when many people help. For example, the whole class can sweep the compound quickly.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for a suitable example, 1 for clear expression.

short.q: List three things you can do to remember what you have read.
short.answer: Write new words and meanings; say one sentence about each chapter; draw a story map; retell the story to a partner.

short.q: Tell in three sentences how to set up a reading club.
short.answer: Agree on a regular time and a quiet place. Each member reads a book they have chosen. Take turns to tell the group about it and keep a list of the books read.

short.q: Write the -ing form of each verb: make, run, play, lie.
Change to the past progressive: 'The children are singing in the hall.'
short.answer: The children were singing in the hall.
short.working: 1 mark for were, 1 mark for keeping singing.

short.q: Write one sentence using 'while' with the past progressive.
short.answer: For example: Mother was cooking while I was doing my homework.
short.working: 1 mark for while, 1 for was/were, 1 for verb-ing forms used correctly.

short.q: Explain why we do not say 'I am knowing the answer'. Give the correct sentence.
short.answer: 'Know' is a state verb, not an action in progress, so it is not normally used in the progressive form. The correct sentence is 'I know the answer.'
short.working: 1 mark for state verb explanation, 1 for the correct sentence, 1 for clear expression.

short.q: Write one sentence in the present progressive and one in the past progressive about a farm.
short.answer: For example: The farmer is digging the field. The cows were eating grass.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the correct form of be, 1 for the -ing verb.

short.q: Rewrite with correct capital letters and full stops: 'we visited lake victoria in august'
short.answer: We visited Lake Victoria in August.
short.working: 1 mark for We, 1 mark for Lake Victoria and August, 1 mark for the full stop.

short.q: Explain the difference between a common noun and a proper noun. Give one example of each.
short.answer: A common noun is a general name such as 'town'. A proper noun is the special name of one person, place or thing, such as 'Kisumu', and begins with a capital letter.
short.working: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 for both examples.

short.q: List three places where we use a capital letter.
short.answer: The first word of a sentence; the word I; names of people; names of places; days and months (any three).

short.q: Correct the paragraph: 'last friday our class visited the museum. mr. juma told us about kenya.'
short.answer: Last Friday our class visited the museum. Mr. Juma told us about Kenya.
short.working: 1 mark each for Last Friday, Mr. Juma, Kenya and correct full stops.
